propositions: Ticking acceptance-criteria checkboxes does not invalidate plan-review attestations because checkbox state is normalized out of the composite fingerprint by _normalize_checkbox_state

Staleness messages currently name a fixed fictional list (description/AC/file_impact/children) rather than the actual components that changed, making it impossible for operators to identify the true cause of attestation invalidation
The material basis is a composite sha256 over exactly four keys (ticket_id, description, file_impact, children) plus file_impact_scope when scope is none; AC is not a basis component

Per-component fingerprints must come from the signed manifest, not reconstructed at read time, because children is derived from other tickets' parent_id and legacy attestations predate the normalization

After this fix, stale-material reasons must name the specific changed components with before/after counts rather than reciting a fixed list, and multiple surfaces (unsigned gate, stale-reopened, generation, resign, completion) must forward component-specific reasons instead of generic advice
